    Profile

    The younger sister of Yna Ku, Benika lives in the Avaritia Belt Region. She was born quite weak, and has lived life with her older brother as a protector and caretaker. But through an encounter with Luke who can change corruption into power, she acquires power to be able to fight alongside her older brother.

    Origin: Avaritia Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 143cm
    Weight: 34kg
    Birthday: May 27
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Spending time with her brother
    Hobbies: Pleasant strolls on nice days
    Illust: 渡り棒（G-ROW）
    CV: 城咲名津
